post.originalText:
I CAN’T DRIVE. SO I BUILT AN ENTIRE DRIVING SCHOOL. 🤯🚗

 I asked claude opus 5.5  to build a game that is close to real driving as much as possible. 

It’s a manual car you drive in your browser: clutch, race, brake, gear stick and handbrake. It acts like a real car:

Lift the clutch too fast → the engine stalls
Change gear without pressing the clutch → the gearbox grinds
Give a little race, lift the clutch slowly to the bite point → the car moves

A tutor called Captain Clutch sits next to you and tells you every step. When you stall, he shows a small graph of what your feet did, so you can see exactly what went wrong.

6 lessons:

Move off without stalling
Shift up from 1st to 3rd
Stop at a red light
Hill start without rolling back
Turn left at a junction
Reverse into a parking bay (with a parking camera)

Then a free drive in Abids, Hyderabad:

Speed camera → ₹1,000 challan
Go too fast → Captain Clutch’s soul leaves the car 
Still too fast → he presses his own brake
Police stop you and ask for your documents (don’t hand them a biryani bill)
Speed breakers, potholes and a buffalo crossing
Drive smooth long enough → Captain Clutch falls asleep 😴

How to play on a laptop:
Z = clutch down, A = lift the clutch slowly
↑ = race, ↓ = brake
1–5, R, N = gears, Space = handbrake
On a phone, use the pedals and gear stick on the screen. 

play for free. Link in the first reply ! 

@claudeai @karpathy @elonmusk  @waiting4_asi
